results.rationale: Consistency: The white setting and two-bag arrangement remain, but the small bag has a different gathered mouth, rope/bead positions and weave; both printed figures and fabric folds are redrawn. These are multiple non-requested changes. Instruction: The right bag remains much taller and wider than the left; a successful edit would shrink it to the left bag’s size. The requested size match is absent. Quality: Structure ✔, naturalness ✔, artifact-free ✔, texture ✔; the burlap, cords, beads and soft grounding shadows are coherent.

Consistency: The foot orientation, dark sock and exposed ankle remain, but knit texture is noticeably coarser throughout the sock, a pronounced toe seam appears, and the background gains visible mottled texture. Instruction: The exposed-skin hole at the heel is replaced by continuous dark fabric; an intact sock is the expected completion, and the visible hole is fully repaired. Quality: Structure ✔, naturalness ✔, artifact-free ✔, texture ✔; the foot and knitted covering have coherent contours and lighting, with no distracting artifacts.
